mapper.sql: id, symbol, sec_type, market, name, pinyin_abbr, status, currency, upstream_secid, missing_days, last_active_date, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quote_security WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND sec_type = #{secType} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM quote_security WHERE sec_type = #{secType} AND symbol IN #{s}
SELECT FROM quote_security WHERE market = #{market} AND sec_type = 1 AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quote_security WHERE market = #{market} AND sec_type = 1 AND status = 1
SELECT FROM quote_security WHERE market = #{market} AND sec_type = 1 AND status = 1 ORDER BY symbol, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quote_security (symbol, sec_type, market, name, pinyin_abbr, status, currency, upstream_secid, missing_days, last_active_date) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{secType}, #{market}, #{name}, #{pinyinAbbr}, #{status}, #{currency}, #{upstreamSecid}, #{missingDays}, #{lastActiveDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE market = VALUES(market), name = VALUES(name), pinyin_abbr = VALUES(pinyin_abbr), status = VALUES(status), currency = VALUES(currency), upstream_secid = VALUES(upstream_secid), missing_days = 0, last_active_date = VALUES(last_active_date)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quote_security WHERE UPPER(symbol) LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') ORDER BY LENGTH(symbol), symbol LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM quote_security WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY LENGTH(name), symbol LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM quote_security WHERE pinyin_abbr LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') ORDER BY LENGTH(pinyin_abbr), symbol LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE quote_security SET missing_days = missing_days + 1, status = IF(missing_days + 1 >= #{threshold}, 2, status), last_active_date = #{lastActiveDate} WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND sec_type = 1 AND (last_active_date IS NULL OR last_active_date < #{lastActiveDate})
